title: Pony Tails Riding Center
specs: Specializes in beginner to intermediate riders in English, Western, pleasure, jumping, and dressage disciplines
Additional barn animals include goats and barn kitties
Beginner camps for ages 6 and older
Long pants and shoes with a small heel recommended; beginners may wear gym shoes
Campers may borrow a Pony Tails helmet or bring a well fitting bike helmet
Small class sizes with no more than two students for private and semi-private lessons; larger groups available on request
Summer camps limited to five riders per camp
